name: nerdynik
description: A personal collection of Claude Code plugins and standalone Agent Skills by nerdynik.

plugins.name: nerdynik-obsidian-toolkit
plugins.description: General-purpose Obsidian vault skills, independent of any industry or practice. Currently covers reading and reasoning over plan data written by the Obsidian Project Manager community plugin (obsidian-pm) — projects, milestones, tasks, subtasks, and their frontmatter schema.

plugins.name: nerdynik-obsidian-ps-toolkit
plugins.description: Skills for working inside Obsidian vaults on Professional Services, C&SI, and SI engagements: the customer/partner/practice/company folder taxonomy, tracking people across accounts and projects, and daily summaries built from call recordings and calendar data. Pairs with nerdynik-obsidian-toolkit for Project Manager plan data, and with nerdynik-plaud-toolkit when recordings come from Plaud.

plugins.name: nerdynik-plaud-toolkit
plugins.description: Retrieving and correctly interpreting recordings, transcripts, and AI notes from a Plaud account. Bundles the official Plaud MCP server and a skill covering the parts that bite: context-heavy responses, a paraphrasing "polished" transcript that must never be quoted, diarization that merges two speakers into one turn, UTC-vs-local timestamp mismatches, and the proper-noun glossary loop that keeps mistranscribed names out of downstream notes.

plugins.name: nerdynik-task-management
plugins.description: Conventions for running task lists that stay useful at scale: customer/project naming, labels as the cross-project correlation axis for practices and partners, role-level saved views, and an OKR structure spanning long-term objectives, mid-term key results, and short-term SMART goals across as many independently scoped goal sets as you track. Bundles the Vikunja MCP server, with the conventions written to port to other task trackers.
